selection: All six first-completed seed0 conditions, fixed before own cutoff results and before any unified-study HOTA.
comparators: FULL_FINAL and ordinary FRAME/FLAT soft/hard FINAL/MEAN; both count donors and own-count checks.
purpose: Check actual saved float32 probability ties at cross-CountMatched cutoffs before interpreting ranking effects.
nontrivial_cutoff: 0 < donor selected count < number of frame candidates
exact_tie: rank score at n-1 equals rank score at n in descending order; no tolerance
own_count_invariant: Threshold-generated own count cannot split an equal-score group.
limitations: This is seed0 precision coverage only; ties do not quantify GT errors or recover discarded logit ordering.
